A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Our advanced, multi-cloud platform delivers real-time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer (GCP) to design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure powering our global payments platform. As a senior technical specialist, you will own cloud architecture decisions across Google Cloud Platform, contribute to multi-cloud implementations, and ensure our infrastructure meets strict performance, security, and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure cloud architectures on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Define, implement, and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform to ensure repeatable and reliable deployments.
  • Architect, build, and support multi-cloud environments aligned with business and platform strategy.
  • Implement and maintain cloud security controls aligned with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and other regulatory standards.
  • Maintain cloud migration initiatives from on-premises environments to GCP, ensuring minimal disruption and optimal performance.
  • Continuously optimize cloud environments for cost efficiency, scalability, observability, and resilience.

Optional

  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes (GKE) clusters and Kafka platforms to support distributed, high-throughput systems.

Requirements

What it takes to succeed

---## Nutricionista**Rio de Janeiro - RJ****Salário de R$ 4.579,53****Escala 12x36**---### DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA\*\*\*\*\*\*TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS SÃO ELEGÍVEIS PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA E REABILITADOS INSS.\*\*\*\*\*\*Prestar assistência dietética e promover educação nutricional à indivíduos em nível hospitalar ou ambulatorial, visando a promoção, manutenção e recuperação da saúde; Zelar pela ordem e manutenção de boas condições higiênicas, observando e analisando o ambiente interno, orientando e supervisionando os funcionários e providenciando medidas adequadas para solucionar os problemas pertinentes, a fim de oferecer alimentação sadia e o aproveitamento de alimentos; Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade; Acompanhar o trabalho do pessoal auxiliar, supervisionando o preparo de alimentos, distribuição de refeições, recebimento dos gêneros alimentícios, sua armazenagem e distribuição, visando evitar a deterioração e perdas; Atualizar diariamente as dietas de pacientes, mediante prescrição médica; Recomendar processos, métodos e rotinas de trabalho que assegurem uma maior e mais eficiente produtividade aliada a uma minimização à perda de alimentos; Prestar assistência dietoterápica hospitalar, ambulatorial e em nível de consultório de nutrição e dietética, prescrevendo, planejando e analisando, visando a melhora de dieta para enfermos; Preparar lista de compras de produtos utilizados, baseando-se nos cardápios, no número de refeições a serem servidas e no estoque existente; Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental; Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática; Realizar a orientação alimentar para pacientes ou familiares/responsáveis no momento de alta hospitalar, a fim de promover melhor educação alimentar; Participar de visitas médicas aos leitos, interagindo com a equipe multiprofissional, definindo sempre que pertinente os procedimentos complementares à prescrição médica; Prescrever suplementos nutricionais necessários à complementação da dieta; Executar atividades afins, de acordo com suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.### REQUISITOS DA VAGAESCOLARIDADE MÍNIMO: Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição. DESEJÁVEL: Pós-graduação. EXPERIÊNCIA NA ÁREA MÍNIMO: 02 anos DESEJÁVEL: 03 anos HABILITAÇÃO/CERTIFICAÇÕES Não aplicável.### INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS**Contrato:** CLT---#### Informações úteisTermine de preencher o seu perfil e receba mais oportunidades dentro do seu perfil!

title: LÍDER DE PRODUCAO - 2º Turno
description:
Localização: RJ-RIO DE JANEIRO, Rio de Janeiro, BR

Se você procura boas oportunidades para sua carreira e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador, agradável, inclusivo e diverso, aFQM é o lugar certo!
Se você tem em interesse e perfil para fazer parte do nosso time, aplique-se à seleção.

Tenha facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis;

Possua visão orientada a dados;

Tenha habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;

Tenha bom planejamento do tempo;

Tenha brilho nos olhos e seja protagonista da sua carreira... Seu lugar é aqui!

Responsabilidades e Qualificações

  • Supervisionar e controlar atividades de natureza técnica e o grupo de colaboradores sob sua responsabilidade, acompanhando os centros de trabalho e processos sob a sua responsabilidade, planejando o fluxo de produção, visando o cumprimento do Takt, assegurar a qualidade do processo produtivo, com o mínimo de atrasos e falhas possíveis.
  • Definir parâmetros e indicadores de pesagem e ordem de produção, avaliando relatórios de conferencia de quantidades, códigos e registros de insumos, com o objetivo de garantir a fidedignidade dos dados presentes nos relatórios que sustentam tomadas de decisão.
  • Liderar a manipulação de matérias-primas / granel / materiais de embalagem, orientando a realização do correto preenchimento das mesmas e do controle de processo, de forma a garantir a qualidade do produto acabado.
  • Liderar a operação de equipamentos do centro produtivo em que esta alocado, orientando e monitorando ajustes de regulagem, visando garantir a continuidade e qualidade da produção sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Participar de reuniões com áreas de interface, realizando apontamentos de OEE referentes ao equipamento pelo qual e responsável, a fim de promover a continuidade dos processos produtivos por meio do compartilhamento de informações de performance diárias.
  • Liderar o controle de índices de produção, avaliando os resultados obtidos em cálculos de produção, a fim de propor melhorias que resultem na diminuição de perdas, na garantia da qualidade do produto e na continuidade do processo produtivo.
  • Orientar e fiscalizar as montagens de equipamentos de operação, garantindo o perfeito estado de funcionamento para a manipulação do produto, seguindo os padrões pré-estabelecidos de processo, limpeza e setup e monitorando os registros nos logbooks específicos, com o objetivo de assegurar o preparo e a conservação da área de trabalho sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Liderar o envio de amostras de lotes em processo de fabricação, orientando a seleção e encaminhamento dos produtos solicitados para áreas de interface, a fim de garantir o controle e a qualidade das amostras enviadas.
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na função.
  • Vivência com liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Conhecimento em BPF – Boas Práticas de Fabricação.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação das 15h40 às 00h03.
  • Atuação em projetos de melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com indicadores operacionais (OEE, rendimento, perdas).
  • Participação em frentes multidisciplinares.

Benefícios

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Alimentação no Local.
  • Vale-alimentação.
  • Assistência médica (plano Bradesco ou Unimed).
  • Assistência odontológica (Odontoprev).
  • Auxílio academia (Wellhub/Gympass).
  • Crédito consignado.

  • Seguro pet.
  • Previdência privada.
  • Medicamentos gratuitos.

  • Auxílio ótica.

  • Seguro de vida.
  • E muito mais!

title: ANALISTA DE INDICADORES E MONITORAMENTO JUNIOR
description:
O Grupo Granado abre as portas para você!

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Indicadores e Monitoramento Junior para fazer parte da nossa equipe. Se você é uma pessoa organizada, dinâmica e comprometida, esta pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar a implementação e evolução de indicadores de desempenho alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Monitorar indicadores e resultados operacionais (recebimento, armazenagem, expedição, entregas e suprimentos), identificando tendências, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas, transformando dados em insights para tomada de decisão.
  • Acompanhar a performance de parceiros logísticos (nacionais e internacionais), custos de transporte e compras de materiais diretos e indiretos.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente processos de contratação e negociação de transportadoras parceiras.
  • Manter e evoluir sistemas e ferramentas de coleta, análise e reporte de dados que suportam a operação de Supply.
  • Desenvolver soluções internas e fluxos automatizados para aumento de eficiência, redução de retrabalho e padronização de processos.
  • Contribuir com iniciativas de melhoria contínua e digitalização das rotinas da área.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com análise de dados e construção de dashboards em ferramentas de BI.
  • Conhecimento em extração, tratamento e interpretação de dados para geração de indicadores.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Conhecimento em lógica de dados e consultas (SQL será considerado diferencial).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções para coleta de dados e automação de processos.
  • Conhecimento em Power Apps e Power Automate.

Informações adicionais

Confira o que você pode esperar:

  • Um ambiente integrado, leve e acolhedor, onde a colaboração, o respeito e a parceria fazem parte da nossa rotina.
  • Horário flexível, promovendo mais autonomia para você organizar sua rotina e ganhar qualidade de vida.
  • Vale-Refeição, para você aproveitar suas pausas com tranquilidade e bons momentos.
  • Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida, porque cuidar de você e de quem você ama é prioridade.
  • TotalPass, incentivando o movimento, a energia e o equilíbrio entre corpo e mente.
  • Descontos exclusivos nas nossas marcas: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty — porque quem faz parte também merece aproveitar.
  • Um ambiente que estimula a criatividade, a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo, com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do Programa de Educação Continuada, que inclui subsídios para cursos de aprimoramento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias educacionais com instituições como Estácio e Open English, facilitando ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados, valorizando e reconhecendo quem cresce junto e contribui com nossa história.
  • Kit Bebê Granado, um carinho especial para colaboradores que se tornam papais ou mamães, celebrando a chegada do seu bebê com produtos desenvolvidos com o cuidado e a tradição que fazem parte da nossa história.

Escritório no Edifício Vista Guanabara , com uma vista inspiradora que traz mais leveza e bem-estar à rotina de trabalho.

Aqui, tradição e inovação caminham lado a lado — e você pode fazer parte disso!

title: Product Designer
description:
Olá, muito prazer, nós somos a inChurch!

Somos a maior plataforma de tecnologia para igrejas da América Latina. Estamos presente em mais de 45 mil ministérios em 32 países impactando a vida de milhões de usuários.

Fomos reconhecidos pela Endeavor integrando o programa ScaleUp, representamos o Brasil no Santander X Global, e integramos o Google for Startups Cloud Program. Mais do que tecnologia (apps, sites, gestão, eventos e mais), entregamos propósito: atrair, cuidar e capacitar pessoas. Se você quer usar seu talento para gerar impacto real com uma stack moderna e um time colaborativo, a inChurch é o seu lugar.

Buscamos um Product Designer, alguém comvisão de produto, domínio de UX/UI, boa comunicação e capacidade de defender o design como um agente estratégico na construção da cultura de produto.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Atuar emsquads multidisciplinares , colaborando com PMs, tech leads e stakeholders para criar soluções centradas nas pessoas.
  • Contribuir compesquisas, prototipação e validação de ideias , traduzindo necessidades em experiências intuitivas e acessíveis.
  • Propor e desenvolver soluções de produto com o uso de inteligência artificial.
  • Representar o design nas discussões estratégicas,defendendo boas práticas e promovendo uma cultura de produto sólida .
  • Criar e manterjornadas, fluxos e interfaces utilizando ferramentas como Figma.
  • Ajudar a evoluir nossoDesign System e garantir consistência entre plataformas.
  • Participar depesquisas com usuários e transformar insights em decisões de design.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida emUX/UI e design centrado no usuário.
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Product Designer .
  • Domínio deFigma e vontade de aprender continuamente.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade paraarticular decisões de design com clareza e empatia .
  • Visão estratégica e pensamento orientado a produto.
  • Conhecimento básico emIA aplicada a produto (ex: uso de LLMs como ChatGPT, geração de conteúdo, automações, etc.).
  • Experiência comDesign Systems .

Diferenciais que contam (mas não eliminam):

  • Ter atuado emstartups ou ambientes ágeis .
  • Interesse ou envolvimento com ouniverso cristão .
  • Estar por dentro das tendências emproduto, IA e design .
  • Conhecimento emLLMs, como usar, criar prompts eficazes e aplicar modelos de linguagem em soluções de produto.
  • Experiência básica naconstrução de agentes com IA — como LangChain, AutoGen ou fluxos autônomos com GPTs.

Se você quer crescer profissionalmente, atuar em um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e participar da construção de produtos com impacto real, vem com a gente!

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean Policy

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

RESPONSIBILITIES

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Orgulhosamente, somos um dos principais bancos do Brasil. Aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Estamos sempre em busca de melhorias, aprendizado contínuo e inovação. Procuramos pessoas que sejam apaixonadas por mudanças, que tenham vontade de aprender e queiram crescer no mercado financeiro. Se você se identifica, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Participação em reuniões estratégicas com o líder do time;

  • Ótima habilidade comercial e relação interpessoal;
  • Experiência mercado financeiro com público de PJ.

Uma história de mais de 60 anos de solidez e inovação.

Em 1961 foi fundado o Banco Sofisa, em uma jornada de transformação, adaptação e principalmente inovação.

Hoje, temos orgulho em ser um dos principais bancos do Brasil. O motivo disso é incentivar e acreditar no empreendedor brasileiro, fortalecendo relacionamentos apoiados na ética e no respeito. Um dos fatores que nos destacam no mercado é o comprometimento dos nossos colaboradores, com forte espírito empreendedor e uma paixão que os fazem vestir a camisa como se fossem donos. É essa mesma motivação que nos leva a prêmios e conquistas notáveis, como o de Melhor Banco do Brasil, em um ranking realizado pela Forbes, no ano de 2023.

Por aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Acreditamos que sempre podemos melhorar, aprender, investir e buscar o novo. A melhora contínua é um processo diário. Em 2011, inauguramos uma nova categoria de serviços bancários no Brasil, lançando o primeiro banco digital de investimentos: o Sofisa Direto. Com isso, encontramos a oportunidade ideal para manter os nossos clientes motivados a buscar os seus objetivos. Em toda a história, os negócios do Banco Sofisa foram construídos por uma sólida estrutura financeira, assegurada por altos índices de capitalização, fazendo com que os nossos clientes sintam-se seguros, investindo em ativos de qualidade, que muitas das vezes só se encontram por aqui.

Hoje, podemos dizer que vencemos o maior de todos os testes, o teste do tempo. E se esse teste foi vencido, é porque valorizamos quem realmente importa: você, nosso cliente. Cada obstáculo superado, cada desafio vencido são os fundamentos da solidez e a experiência que precisamos para seguir em frente.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
Department

Tournament and Venue Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision‑making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow‑up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow‑up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre‑tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large‑scale international events, preferably in the sports industry.
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow‑up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented mindset with a service‑focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

title: Engineer, Rotational / Aspire Program
description:
Job Description

The Rotational Engineer is an entry-level engineering position for newly graduated engineers. Rotating through each of the core business sectors of ABS, the rotational engineer will spend up to four months each working in engineering, survey, and technology. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the incumbent will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures. Following the completion of each rotation, the engineer will be placed in a permanent role as either Engineer I or Surveyor I.

What You Will Do (under the supervision of an experienced Engineer during the engineering rotation):

  • Performs detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Performs work that involves conventional engineering practices but may include moderately complex problems such as the resolution of conflicting design requirements, material standards, or coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • With the assistance and guidance of an experienced Surveyor during the survey rotation: Visits vessels, marine structures, and manufacturers for routine survey activities.
  • Performs work that involves conventional surveying practices but may include moderately complex problem resolution and coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • Conduct research in support of ship and offshore-related classification and rule development.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • BS degree in a related engineering field, including civil, structural, ocean, marine, mechanical, electrical, or naval architecture.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems.
  • Good command of the English language.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Obtain knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports to the Director, Talent Management. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: Voice and Services Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, related with the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of NGN based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I-CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces - GM Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle and Ribbon IMS products

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

FullStack is the most transparent IT talent network, connecting highly skilled individuals with top global companies and Silicon Valley startups for remote, on-demand projects. We focus on building a trusted, high-performance network where talent can thrive in a positive, respectful, and supportive environment. By prioritizing transparency, fair opportunities, and professional growth, we empower our engineers to deliver their best work while collaborating with innovative teams worldwide.

Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as an Agentic Software Engineer (GitHub Copilot).

Responsibilities

  • You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with a deep understanding of full-stack architectures (e.g., Java, Python, C#, React, Node, etc.).
  • Deep experience using GitHub Copilot as a primary development environment to coordinate AI-driven implementation across large, multi-file systems while maintaining architectural oversight.
  • Experience delivering production software where AI systems generate the majority of implementation code.
  • Strong context engineering skills, including structuring codebases, specifications, and documentation to produce reliable, context-efficient AI output.
  • Ability to translate complex product requirements into machine-executable, AI-friendly specifications.
  • Experience designing AI-first development workflows from specification through deployment.
  • Ability to systematically improve AI-generated output through structured iteration and feedback loops.
  • Comfort working across multiple stacks, using AI to deliver high-quality, production-ready systems.
  • Experience operating across frontend, backend, and infrastructure in AI-accelerated environments.
  • Disciplined human-in-the-loop review practices, with risk-adjusted validation for high-impact or safety-critical flows.
  • Strong curiosity and initiative in evaluating and adopting emerging AI-native engineering practices.
  • Advanced understanding of Agile methodologies and Lean principles and participation in team ceremonies as well as asynchronous work.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients and dedicate yourself to delivering on commitments.
  • Ability to consistently work 40 hours per week.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay.
  • 100% remote work.
  • The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
  • Continuing education opportunities.
  • Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

EEO Statement

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration. title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast‑paced, problem‑solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next‑generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location

This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server‑class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimise applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centres, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self‑discipline and self‑motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Director, Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Brazil
description:
At The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio of more than 200 brands enjoyed by millions globally. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference.

We are seeking a Director, Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Brazil to provide scientific and regulatory leadership across one of our most strategically important markets. This role is pivotal in protecting and expanding the Company’s freedom to operate by ensuring portfolio compliance, enabling innovation, and actively shaping the external regulatory environment through science‑based advocacy . The ideal candidate will bring deep scientific expertise, strong regulatory judgment, and the ability to influence policy and business decisions through credibility and collaboration.

If you are passionate about science‑led advocacy, regulatory leadership, and enabling responsible growth, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do For Us

  • Lead the execution of the Scientific & Regulatory Affairs agenda for Brazil, aligning scientific, regulatory, and advocacy activities with business priorities and regional and global SRA direction.
  • Engage in science‑based regulatory advocacy, contributing technical expertise and evidence to help shape policies, standards, and guidance that impact the Company’s portfolio and future innovation.
  • Serve as the scientific and regulatory authority for claims and marketing communications evaluation and approval, ensuring compliance, credibility, and appropriate substantiation.
  • Ensure compliance continuity across the full portfolio after product launch.
  • Partner closely with Marketing, R&D, Legal, Public Affairs, and Franchise teams to anticipate regulatory risks and enable compliant, timely business decisions.
  • Monitor and assess emerging scientific, regulatory, and public policy trends, translating complexity into clear implications and recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Support the market on IMCRs (Incident Management and Crisis Response), providing scientific and regulatory expertise to enable effective, timely, and compliant responses.
  • Represent the Company with regulators, industry associations, and scientific forums as appropriate, building credibility and constructive dialogue.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Public Health, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in scientific and/or regulatory affairs within food, beverage, consumer goods, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated industries.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian regulatory frameworks, with demonstrated experience engaging with ANVISA and other relevant authorities.
  • Proven expertise in regulatory advocacy, claims substantiation, labeling, marketing communications review, and product compliance across the product life cycle.
  • Ability to influence cross‑functional and external stakeholders in a matrixed organization without direct people management responsibility.
  • Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort operating in complex, evolving regulatory environments.
  • Experience working in emerging markets and within global organizations strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.

What We'll Do For You

  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with regional and global SRA leaders, contributing Brazilian perspectives to enterprise‑level scientific and regulatory strategies.
  • Iconic Brands: Support some of the world’s most trusted and loved brands within a system grounded in science, integrity, and responsibility.
  • Learning & Development: Access continuous scientific learning, regulatory forums, and professional development opportunities.
  • Purpose‑Driven Work: Play a meaningful role in advancing science‑based policy and enabling sustainable, responsible business growth.

Skills

Regulatory Environment; Leadership; Strategic Influence; Regulatory Advocacy; Regulatory Issues; organization; Analytical Thinking; Active Listening; Food Sciences; Food Technology; Risk Management; Communication; Government Affairs; Regulatory Policies; Taking Initiative; Cross-Functional Teamwork

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A Flowa Technologies é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em mercado financeiro e pioneira no segmento de Electronic Trading. Desenvolvemos soluções tecnológicas robustas e eficientes voltadas para a negociação eletrônica de ativos financeiros nas principais bolsas das Américas.

Atuando sob o conceito de “tecnologia como serviço”, atendemos as principais corretoras de valores, gestores de recursos e investidores institucionais do mercado. Temos o compromisso contínuo com o desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes, ágeis e que transformem a experiência de investir, priorizando a estabilidade, velocidade e segurança para os nossos clientes.

Movidos por tecnologia e inovação, sede de aprendizado contínuo e vontade de fazer a diferença, somos um time comprometido e apaixonado pelo que fazemos.

No seu dia a dia você irá atuar com:

  • Colaborar na elaboração de serviços e produtos na área de dados;
  • Desenvolver soluções envolvendo a extração, centralização, garantia da qualidade, governança dos dados e geração de novas métricas para o negócio;
  • Sugerir melhorias e otimizações em pipelines, modelos de dados e processos existentes;
  • Participar da transição dos serviços e aplicações para a nuvem (AWS);
  • Criar, manter e evoluir pipelines de dados automatizadas e escaláveis;
  • Implantar pipelines de dados em ambiente AWS;
  • Contribuir na implementação de soluções para entrega de dados, incluindo relatórios, dashboards e APIs de dados.

O que você precisa:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em programação Python, PySpark, Kafka, consumo de APIs e SDKs;
  • Experiência com processos de ETL, integração de dados e boas práticas de qualidade e confiabilidade de dados;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, modelagem de dados, SQL e Data Lakes e Warehouses;
  • Familiaridade com AWS Glue (Jobs e Catalog), S3 como camada de storage e Athena para consultas federadas;
  • Vivência com versionamento de código, automação de pipelines e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Domínio de Arquiteturas Modernas: Sólidos conhecimentos no desenho e implementação de arquiteturas de dados (Data Lakehouse, Data Lake e Data Warehouse), com visão crítica orientada a custo (FinOps).

Serão considerados como diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em C# e .NET;
  • Conhecimentos relacionados ao mercado financeiro e/ou experiência anterior nesse segmento;
  • Inglês avançado.

A Flowa é movimento, crescimento e evolução. Aqui você encontrará um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde todos são protagonistas. Se você busca uma oportunidade de crescimento e quer fazer parte de uma equipe engajada no propósito de transformar o mercado de electronic trading, vem com a gente!

Qualificações

Oportunidades para SP/ RJ/ BH.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A&M way.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train-the-Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Você vai gravar, editar e entregar materiais prontos para o nosso Gestor(a) de Mídias Sociais , seguindo o planejamento de marketing e com direção do Gerente de Marketing .

Criar conteúdo presencial (foto e vídeo) de imóveis e pessoas (equipe/sócios/parceiros e, quando autorizado, hóspedes e proprietários), transformando o dia a dia e o inventário em conteúdo publicável para Instagram/Reels e campanhas.

Produzir conteúdo presencial (foto e vídeo) de imóveis e de pessoas, com foco em comunicar a estratégia da empresa e executar o planejamento de marketing, entregando materiais gravados + editados prontos para publicação e performance. (Contexto: experiência de hospedagem, conforto, localização, atendimento e confiança.)

Principais responsabilidades

  • Captação presencial de fotos e vídeos de imóveis (ambientes, detalhes, “tour”, amenities, vizinhança e pontos de interesse).
  • Captação de pessoas: sócios, equipe, hóspedes (quando autorizado), parceiros e proprietários (depoimentos, bastidores, rotinas e “provas sociais”).
  • Seguir roteiros e direção do Gerente de Marketing (objetivo do conteúdo, ângulo, CTA, tom, padrões de marca).
  • Edição e finalização: Reels/TikTok/Shorts (vertical), cortes, legendas, capas, ritmo. Tratamento básico de fotos (luz, cor, enquadramento). Exportação nos formatos corretos para cada canal.
  • Organizar e nomear arquivos, manter biblioteca de mídia por imóvel/campanha (Google Drive/Dropbox/Notion ou similar).
  • Entregar pacotes semanais de conteúdo para o(a) Gestor(a) de Mídias Sociais com: vídeos finalizados + versões alternativas (quando necessário), fotos tratadas, sugestões de legenda/ganho e CTA (curtas e objetivas).

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência prática com captação em ambiente interno (luz, enquadramento, estabilidade, áudio).
  • Edição de vídeo em CapCut / Premiere / Final Cut / DaVinci (qualquer um, desde que entregue bem).
  • Noções de storytelling para Reels (ganho nos 2 primeiros segundos, cortes, texto na tela, CTA).
  • Agilidade e padrão de qualidade consistente (entregar “publicável”, não “rascunho”).
  • Saber trabalhar com checklists e padrões (marca, briefing, formatos e prazos).

Diferenciais (não obrigatório, mas conta muito)

  • Equipamento próprio (smartphone bom, estabilizador/gimbal, microfone de lapela, iluminação portátil).
  • Experiência com conteúdo de hospitalidade/imobiliário.
  • Noções de fotografia (composição, linhas, correção de perspectiva).
  • Experiência captando depoimentos com pessoas (condução, postura, naturalidade).

Fluxo de trabalho (como a função roda na prática)

  • Brief semanal com o Gerente de Marketing (prioridades, imóveis foco, campanhas, checklists).
  • Captação presencial (com lista de takes obrigatórios por imóvel + cenas de pessoas).
  • Edição (primeiro corte + ajustes).
  • Entrega para o(a) Social Media (pasta organizada + planilha/nota com contexto do conteúdo).
  • Ajustes rápidos conforme feedback (prazo curto).

title: Venue Telecom Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Venue Telecom Manager (VTCM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The VTCM will work closely with the Technology teams in all the stadiums and IBCC and Zurich, as well as other stakeholders, to deliver critical Network and telecommunications solutions for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of telecommunications infrastructure and services across competition and non‑competition venues, including:
  • Broadcast Contribution Network (BCN)
  • Event Network (WAN, MAN, LAN, WLAN, cabling, containment)
  • Internet, VLAN, VPN services, VoIP
  • Mobile Network and Private 5G
  • Push‑to‑Talk/Private Mobile Radios
  • Spectrum Management
  • CATV/IPTV
  • Rate Card services (Internet/IP Codecs)
  • Deploy and oversee technology services across various venues (stadia, training sites, operation centers, accreditation centers, ticketing centers, hotels, airports, and transport hubs).
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA standards in the integration of tournament technology services, such as Accreditation and Ticketing, with the FIFA Event Network environment.
  • Collaborate with Football Technology Innovation suppliers, media, broadcasters, and other functional stakeholders to define and fulfill network and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Coordinate on‑site IT and telecom technical teams for infrastructure testing, acceptance, and operations.
  • Manage incident resolution and ensure adherence to service‑level agreements (SLAs), escalating risks and issues to the Technology Command Center (TCC).
  • Support spectrum management efforts, including interference resolution in collaboration with regulatory authorities and venue teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting, including daily updates to the TCC and post‑event analysis.
  • Participate in pre‑tournament training, readiness exercises, and rehearsals.

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of IT/Technology experience, preferably in major events.
  • Strong knowledge of IT and telecommunications technologies, including CATV, AV systems, radio communications, VLANs and related areas.
  • Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Detail‑oriented and process‑driven with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with experience in similar projects.
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events.
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones.
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge.
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance.
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese.
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset.

Various

  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more).
